prototype.topology: Single-input/multi-output capacitive coupler with LCLC-CLL resonant network for constant-current outputs and load decoupling.
prototype.coupler_type: Capacitive electric-field coupling electrodes
prototype.misalignment_description: The abstract-level record includes a lateral misalignment tolerance result of +/-125 mm. Do not add an angular tolerance until the primary paper's angle definition and test condition are reviewed.
prototype.control_method: Constant-current output, multi-load decoupling and transmitter-side load-adaptive zero-phase-angle operation.

input_boundary.measurement_point: Transmitter-side DC input for the experimental CPT prototype; exact meter node not specified in the abstract.
excludes: Grid/mains front end and unreported auxiliary loads

output_boundary.measurement_point: DC output to a single load at the reported maximum single-load operating point; exact receiver meter node not specified in the abstract.
excludes: Do not interpret as simultaneous output to every receiver in the swarm

efficiency.definition: The abstract reports a separate peak DC-to-DC efficiency; it does not establish that this maximum single-load output occurs at the same operating point.

measurements.load_description: Maximum single-load output in a SIMO multi-UAV charging topology; per-receiver simultaneous output distribution and exact load count at this maximum are not given in the abstract.
measurements.alignment_description: Abstract reports lateral misalignment tolerance to +/-125 mm; angular tolerance is withheld pending primary-source definition review.
measurements.source_locator: Abstract; IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics 41(2), pp.2927-2942; DOI 10.1109/TPEL.2025.3603638.
measurements.notes: 709.9 W is a maximum single-load value, not demonstrated power delivered to each drone simultaneously.

input_boundary.measurement_point: Transmitter-side DC input of the CPT system; exact meter node and included auxiliaries not specified in the abstract.
excludes: Unreported grid/mains conversion and battery-terminal stages

output_boundary.measurement_point: Receiver-side DC output in the reported DC-to-DC efficiency definition; exact meter node not stated in the abstract.
excludes: Any aircraft battery-terminal/mission-use losses not included in the paper's stated boundary

efficiency.definition: Reported peak measured DC-to-DC efficiency. Its operating point is not established as identical to the 709.9 W maximum single-load point.

measurements.load_description: Experimental SIMO CPT prototype with load-count and load-imbalance adaptability; exact output power at the peak-efficiency point is not stated in the abstract.
measurements.alignment_description: The source reports misalignment tolerance; full spatial map and operating-point detail require full-text extraction.
measurements.source_locator: Abstract; IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics 41(2), pp.2927-2942; DOI 10.1109/TPEL.2025.3603638.
measurements.notes: Do not combine this peak efficiency with the separate maximum single-load watt value as one operating point.

limitations: Abstract-level extraction; transfer frequency, physical gap, exact DC meter nodes and load distribution at maximum output require full-text recovery.
Maximum single-load output and peak DC-to-DC efficiency are stored as separate measurements because their co-occurrence is not established.
Angular tolerance is intentionally omitted pending review of the primary paper's angle definition.

claim_audit.claim_text: The experimental SIMO CPT prototype reports a maximum single-load output power of 709.9 W.
claim_audit.notes: Abstract does not identify the exact meter node or number of concurrently active receiver loads at the maximum.

claim_audit.claim_text: The experimental SIMO CPT prototype reports a peak DC-to-DC efficiency of 89.06%.
claim_audit.notes: The abstract does not state that the peak efficiency and maximum single-load output occur at the same test point.

engineering_metrics.name: Reported lateral misalignment tolerance magnitude
engineering_metrics.notes: Abstract reports a lateral offset range of +/-125 mm. Detailed load/efficiency map versus offset requires full text.

publication.title: Telemetry-guided cooperative control for safe mid-air wireless power transfer in autonomous UAV systems

application.description: Simulation-based telemetry-guided cooperative multi-UAV mid-air WPT control; physical transfer modality and hardware coupler are not specified in the abstract.

prototype.topology: Telemetry-guided cooperative rendezvous, multi-phase state machine, adaptive WPT management and continuous control barrier function separation; no physical transmitter/receiver topology stated in the abstract.
prototype.misalignment_description: Simulation-derived relative-position and telemetry profiles; no physical air-gap/coil/antenna alignment experiment is stated.
prototype.control_method: Pseudo-Hamiltonian cooperative guidance, continuous control barrier functions and adaptive WPT modulation.

input_boundary.measurement_point: Simulation energy accounting input to the cooperative WPT model; no hardware electrical meter node is available.
excludes: Physical transmitter mains/DC input and measured converter losses

output_boundary.measurement_point: Simulation receiver-side energy accounting; no hardware battery-terminal meter node is available.
excludes: Physical receiver rectifier and battery-terminal efficiency unless represented in the simulation model

efficiency.definition: Mean Energy Transfer Efficiency reported across eight simulation-based Monte Carlo realizations; not a measured hardware DC-to-DC efficiency.

measurements.load_description: Telemetry-guided cooperative multi-UAV WPT simulation; telemetry derived from an open UAV Autonomous Navigation Dataset.
measurements.alignment_description: Rendezvous and relative-separation behavior evaluated in simulation; no hardware transfer-gap or misalignment measurement.
measurements.source_locator: Abstract and data-availability statement; Array 31 (2026), article 101149; DOI 10.1016/j.array.2026.101149.
measurements.notes: Eight simulation realizations; collision-free simulations do not establish flight-test safety. ETE definition is specific to the simulation and is not directly comparable to prototype DC-to-DC values.

source_refs.locator: Abstract; data availability; DOI 10.1016/j.array.2026.101149.

limitations: Simulation/controller evidence only; no physical WPT hardware demonstration is reported in the abstract.
Exact electrical energy boundaries, transfer modality, frequency, distance and hardware efficiency are not stated.
Eight Monte Carlo realizations are not eight independent physical flight trials.

claim_audit.claim_text: The simulation reports mean Energy Transfer Efficiency of 38.16% across eight Monte Carlo realizations.
claim_audit.notes: Simulation-specific metric without physical electrical meter boundaries; do not place on measured prototype DC-to-DC leaderboard.

claim_audit.claim_text: The simulation reports an Energy Fairness Index of 1.0000.

engineering_metrics.notes: Simulation result across the reported Monte Carlo ensemble.

engineering_metrics.name: Mission Endurance Index
engineering_metrics.notes: Mean reported across eight simulation realizations; not measured flight endurance.

engineering_metrics.notes: All eight simulation realizations avoided collisions; this is not flight-test evidence.
